apps.title: GuardianShield Safety
apps.tagline: Real-time AI geofencing, panic alerts & screen safety monitoring for families.
apps.description: GuardianShield empowers parents with instant location tracking, safe boundary alerts, emergency SOS dispatch, and content filtering. Built with zero privacy compromises and end-to-end encrypted device-to-device streaming.

screenshots.title: Live Geofence Radar
screenshots.description: Interactive map showing real-time GPS coordinates and safe zones.

screenshots.title: Emergency SOS HUD
screenshots.description: One-touch panic button triggering silent police/family contact broadcast.

screenshots.title: Digital Wellness Analytics
screenshots.description: App usage insights and intelligent content safety filtering.

features.title: Smart Geofencing
features.detail: Instant push notifications when family members enter or leave designated safe zones.

features.title: One-Tap Emergency SOS
features.detail: Sends encrypted audio, video snippet, and live coordinates to emergency contacts.

features.title: Tamper-Proof Guardian Mode
features.detail: Prevents unauthorized uninstallation or setting changes without guardian PIN.

apps.title: CipherVault Messenger
apps.tagline: Zero-knowledge encrypted messaging, self-destructing chats & quantum-resistant keys.
apps.description: CipherVault is the premier confidential communication app engineered for total privacy. Features Double Ratchet end-to-end encryption, ephemeral media destruction, anonymous voice calling, and peer-to-peer relaying.

screenshots.title: Encrypted Chat Console
screenshots.description: Clean interface with self-destruct timers and anti-screenshot shielding.

screenshots.title: Quantum Key Exchange
screenshots.description: Visual key fingerprint verification for trusted contact sessions.

features.title: Post-Quantum Key Exchange
features.detail: Protects communication against future quantum computing decryption threats.

features.title: Stealth Cover Mode

features.title: Decoy Vault Passcode
features.detail: Opens a secondary clean workspace if forced to unlock under pressure.

apps.title: AutoRescue Roadside & Mechanic
apps.tagline: On-demand roadside assistance, mobile mechanic dispatch & OBD-II vehicle diagnostics.
apps.description: AutoRescue connects stranded drivers with certified mobile mechanics, tow operators, and battery jump services in under 15 minutes. Includes live mechanic GPS tracking, upfront price lock, and bluetooth OBD-II diagnostic scanning.

screenshots.title: Live Mechanic Radar
screenshots.description: Track nearest service vehicle ETA in real time on the interactive map.

screenshots.title: OBD-II Fault Scanner
screenshots.description: Read engine trouble codes with clear plain-language repair estimates.

features.title: Sub-15 Min Rapid Dispatch
features.detail: Algorithmic routing dispatches the nearest certified provider directly to your GPS coordinates.

features.title: Guaranteed Upfront Quotes
features.detail: Transparent pricing for towing, tire changes, fuel delivery, and lockout services.

features.title: Engine Diagnostic Scanner
features.detail: Connects via Bluetooth OBD-II dongle to diagnose check engine lights immediately.

apps.title: CyberVault Security Suite
apps.tagline: Hardware-backed password manager, dark web breach monitoring & biometric authenticator.
apps.description: CyberVault protects your digital identities with hardware-backed zero-knowledge encryption. Includes biometric auto-fill, passkey support, compromised password dark-web alerts, and encrypted file storage.

screenshots.title: Biometric Authenticator
screenshots.description: Seamless passwordless passkey login and 2FA OTP generator.

features.title: Zero-Knowledge Vault
features.detail: Your master key never leaves your device. Not even Roigroupes can view your passwords.

features.title: Dark Web Breach Scanner
features.detail: Automatic continuous scanning for leaked emails and credentials in data dumps.
